success_criteria.description: SUCCESS = summary.md exists in the sandbox root, has >= 50 words, and contains >= 3 of the keywords governance, policy, audit, approval, canary (case-insensitive).

fixtures.content:
# Architecture
The governance layer sits between the agent and its tools. Every tool call passes through the ToolExecutor, which checks identity, evaluates policy, scans for data loss, and enforces rate limits before anything executes.

# Policy
Policy is declared in YAML: roles map to allowed tools, egress destinations are allowlisted, and risky actions require human approval through the approval queue. Deny wins over allow.

# Audit
Every decision is appended to a hash-chained audit log, so auditors can verify exactly what happened. Egress canaries act as tripwires: fake credentials that halt the run if an agent tries to exfiltrate them.
